title: BPSC District Sports Officer DSO Marks 2026
vacancyDetails: Marks release for BPSC District Sports Officer recruitment
selectionProcess: Written / Interview stages as per notification → Marks → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Roll number / registration for marks download
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bpsc.bih.nic.in
2. Open Marks / Result section
3. Download DSO marks PDF or login as instructed
4. Check score
shortDescription: BPSC District Sports Officer (DSO) Marks 2026 released. Check marks at bpsc.bih.nic.in.
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released District Sports Officer (DSO) Marks 2026.

Candidates can download marks from the official BPSC website and wait for further merit / appointment updates.
